title: Review of the upload handler
intro: Three findings. Each shows the fix as a diff. Post a finding as a review comment, fix it yourself, or drop it.

questions.text:
**Before:** the handler reads the whole body into memory, then checks its size. **After:** it checks the `Content-Length` header first and refuses a body over 10 MB before it reads a byte.

Risk: a client can send 2 GB and take the process down.

options.label: Fix it
options.description: Push the change to the branch.

questions.text:
**Before:** the file is stored under the name the client sent. **After:** it is stored under a generated id.

Risk: a name such as `../../etc/cron.d/x` writes outside the upload folder.

**Before:** a refused upload logs the whole request, headers included. **After:** it logs the path and the reason.

Risk: low. The headers carry a session token.
